integrity: All integer DP states and an independently evaluated deterministic policy are reproducible with verify.py; no third-party copyrighted full text is included.
scientific_limitations: An exact six-round, three-label, two-copy result proved by exhaustive Bellman recurrences; no generalization to larger decks or human-independent validation. The earlier optimal mean is credited as known; priority of the full score law and optimal-policy invariance remains subject to unpublished historical computations.
title: Policy-invariant optimal score law for the first repeated three-label guessing deck
